drivingQuestion: From where is it derived that a priest who redeemed the field may not keep it at the Jubilee?
outcomeNote: the a fortiori is defeated by ״אחוזתו״ and the mishna's ruling is grounded

segments.he: מִנַּיִן לְשָׂדֶה שֶׁיּוֹצָא לַכֹּהֲנִים בַּיּוֹבֵל, וּגְאָלָהּ אֶחָד מִן הַכֹּהֲנִים, מִנַּיִן שֶׁלֹּא יֹאמַר: ״הוֹאִיל וְיוֹצְאָה לַכֹּהֵן, הֲרֵי תַּחַת יָדִי, וּתְהֵא שֶׁלִּי?״ וְדִין הוּא: בְּשֶׁל אֲחֵרִים אֲנִי זוֹכֶה, בְּשֶׁל עַצְמִי לֹא כׇּל שֶׁכֵּן?
segments.en: The baraita explains: «From where» is it derived, «with regard to a field that» was consecrated and not redeemed by the owner, and therefore «was» to have been «removed» from the possession of the owner and given «to the priests during the Jubilee» Year, «and one of the priests redeemed it» before the Jubilee, «from where» is it derived «that he may not say: Since it is removed» from the possession of the owner and given «to the priest» at the Jubilee, «and» since it is already «in my possession,» it «should» therefore «be mine? And this» claim is supported by «a logical inference:» Since in the Jubilee Year «I obtain» fields «of others» that I did not previously redeem, is it «not all the more so» clear «that» I should retain «my own» field that I redeemed from the Temple treasury myself?

segments.he: תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר: ״אֲחוּזָּתוֹ״, אֲחוּזָּה שֶׁלּוֹ, וְאֵין זֶה שֶׁלּוֹ. הָא כֵּיצַד? יוֹצָא מִתַּחַת יָדוֹ וּמִתְחַלֶּקֶת לְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים.
segments.en: Therefore, «the verse states: “His ancestral possession,”» which can be interpreted to mean that only «his ancestral» field, i.e., one that the priest inherited from his own ancestors, is automatically his, «but this» field «is not his. How so,» i.e., how is this field treated? «It is removed from his possession and is divided among» all of «his brethren, the priests.»

moves.summary: the baraita restates its question: whence that the redeeming priest may not keep it
moves.about: from where it is derived that a priest who redeemed the field may not keep it when the Jubilee arrives

moves.cueHe: ודין הוא: בשל אחרים אני זוכה, בשל עצמי לא כל שכן?
moves.summary: an a fortiori is floated in the priest's favour
moves.about: an a fortiori: if I acquire others' unredeemed fields at the Jubilee, all the more so the one I redeemed myself

moves.cueHe: תלמוד לומר: ״אחוזתו״, אחוזה שלו, ואין זה שלו
moves.summary: the verse defeats the floated a fortiori
moves.about: whether the a fortiori lets the priest who redeemed the field keep it — ״אחוזתו״ defeats it

moves.cueHe: הא כיצד? יוצא מתחת ידו ומתחלקת לאחיו הכהנים
moves.summary: the field is removed from him and divided among all the priests
moves.about: the baraita's conclusion supplies the source for the mishna's ruling that the field is divided among all the priests
